description: A whole clinic app in Svelte 5 on the Scheduler. A NavPane rail switches modules; Schedule is a dockable SvDockManager workspace with the day scheduler as the hero over a live load-by-hour SvGridChart and an Upcoming grid, providers grouped by department through a resource tree, every open slot bookable and appointments keeping a cleanup buffer; Insights is a charting dashboard and Patients a records grid, with live KPIs, and every surface reads the one rows array.

faq.question: How does the load chart follow the schedule?
faq.answer: A $derived counts appointments per hour from the rows and builds an SvGridChart spec; booking a slot adds to the hour's bar immediately.

faq.question: Do the modules share data?
faq.answer: Yes. Schedule, Insights and Patients read the same rows array; the Patients grid is the record view and the scheduler is the time view of the same appointments.

faq.question: How are the panes arranged?
faq.answer: SvDockManager holds the scheduler, chart and Upcoming grid as panes with minSize so none can be crushed; drag, resize and float them, and the arrangement persists.
